text:
GENERATE BURST KV-S — Run C-9 P7, visor consistency (Matt: "make the S and SW visors edited similarly [to SE]. They all need to match."). task_id "KV-S".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight, facing STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER (south), painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). Replace ONLY his HELM so that it is the SAME VISOR as the reference: a projecting rounded visor with ONE narrow horizontal SIGHT SLIT, and directly below the slit ONE row of small round breathing holes following the visor's curve; the same rounded skull, the same dark gouache steel, the same size, seen from the FRONT: the visor projects slightly toward the viewer, the sight slit runs straight across it and the row of holes runs below the slit, symmetric left to right.
Paint it in EXACTLY the same hand as the rest of IMAGE 1. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY as it is: body, pose, direction, gorget, tabard and heraldry, the pollaxe in his right hand, size, position, flat pure #00ff00 background. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the visor does not match the reference design, the helm faces a different way from the body, anything besides the helm changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KV-S_a.png and out/KV-S_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KV-S"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (replace only the helm)
IMAGE 2 — the visor to match (seen from his lower-right diagonal); copy ONLY the helm and visor design
